## W3 - Speed-to-lead
Every 10 minutes, for every ACTIVE clinic that is OPEN right now: finds leads still on Status = New that have waited 30+ minutes
and are not Escalated, runs the send guard, and (once WhatsApp is connected) alerts the clinic OWNER and ticks Escalated.

**Today the send is a STUB.** "Send escalation (stub)" builds the message and sends nothing, and Escalated is not set,
so nothing is lost when WhatsApp goes live. Open an execution and look at that node's output to see what would be sent.

**Clinic hours** come from the clinic's Settings rows open_time (e.g. 09:00), close_time (e.g. 19:00) and working_days (e.g. Mon-Sat).
Missing or unreadable = 08:00-21:00 every day. **Recipient** = Settings owner_phone; with TEST_MODE on (or the row missing) it goes to TEST_PHONE.

**Limits (Config node):** waits 30 min; ignores leads older than 48 h (old backlog); at most 10 alerts per clinic per run, oldest first.

**Set up once:** pick the *Grist API* credential in every Grist (HTTP Request) node, set registry_doc_id in Config
(grist_base_url has no trailing slash), then Activate. Set Settings > Error workflow > W11.
**When WhatsApp is ready:** replace "Send escalation (stub)" with the real send (output sent: true on success).
